WITH input_ids AS (
  SELECT
    value AS id,
    ordinality
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
    $payload${{data.steps.loopOverTransformedAssociations.loopOverItem.products | tojson}}$payload$::jsonb
  ) WITH ORDINALITY
)
SELECT
  p.id,
  (p.product_data->>'enabled')::boolean        AS enabled,
  p.product_data->>'parent'                    AS parent,
  p.product_data->'values'->'sku'->0->>'data'  AS sku
FROM "{{data.var.productsTable}}" p
JOIN input_ids i ON p.id = i.id
ORDER BY i.ordinality;

WITH metafield_payload AS (
  SELECT
    $payload${{data.steps.createAssociationsMetafield.output.data | tojson }}$payload$::jsonb AS data
)
INSERT INTO "{{data.var.bcMetafieldsTable}}"
  (id, data, bc_date_modified, synced_at)
SELECT
  (metafield_payload.data->>'id')::bigint,
  metafield_payload.data,
  NULLIF(metafield_payload.data->>'date_modified','')::timestamptz,
  now()
FROM metafield_payload
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  data             = EXCLUDED.data,
  bc_date_modified = EXCLUDED.bc_date_modified,
  synced_at        = EXCLUDED.synced_at;
